summary: Iteration 4: Validated the Photo Autofill feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering auth (401 unauth, 404 for unknown path and for someone else's file), full response schema, red-on-white colour detection -> 'red', bottle Unsplash URL -> category 'bottles' (uncertain=false, label present, confidence >= 0.30), backpack URL -> 'bags', and plain red square -> category null + uncertain true + confidence < 0.30 (confirms keys/ID cards which have no ImageNet class are never suggested). Frontend: full Snap-to-Report flow as bob with the bottle Unsplash photo -> report form showed 'Suggested from your photo' card with photo-autofill-card / -category / -colors, category select prefilled to 'Bottles & containers' and colour input prefilled to 'green, grey', user override of both works, end-to-end submission created item f76ed001-3d8c-49fd-8f46-49424b0bff12. Regression: direct /report/lost (no snapped photo) correctly shows no autofill card and no snap-attached note.
critical_code_review_comments: photo_autofill.py: category confidence is a sum of per-class probabilities inside a mapped category; this is fine but note that LABELS lookup inside the module-load loop runs O(n*m); harmless given tiny maps.

ReportItem.jsx line 123: CategoryPredictor onPredict guards with `!touched && !(p.uncertain && photoCat)` — correctly keeps the photo-derived category when text ML is uncertain and user hasn't manually picked; good.
PhotoSearch.jsx: SnapToReport uploads the photo only when user clicks 'I lost/found this' — matches the privacy promise shown in the UI copy. Good.
No data-testid on the 'Add photo' PhotoUpload input (not required by this iteration; worth adding later for coverage of manual uploads).
test_credentials: Demo logins via /api/auth/demo-login {email: alice@campus.edu | bob@campus.edu}; UI demo-login-alice / demo-login-bob buttons.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed lost report as bob: 'TEST_Autofill green water bottle' (id f76ed001-3d8c-49fd-8f46-49424b0bff12).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Photo autofill (POST /api/ml/photo-suggest + PhotoAutofill.jsx + ReportItem.jsx snap flow) is working. Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_photo_autofill.py (8 tests, run with `pytest ... -o addopts=''`). Previous iterations covered core (1), photo matching (2), photo search (3). Note: after demo-login, the client auth state needs a short hydration delay before clicking photo-search-btn, otherwise the component redirects to /login (observed; worked around with wait_for header name).
